description: This class provides search utilities and constraints for querying WorkEffort entities in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for executing complex searches with various constraints like associations, keyword searches, date ranges, and related entities. The class supports constructing dynamic view entities, applying filters, sorting, and saving search results. It also defines a set of nested classes representing different search constraints and sorting orders, which can be combined to form comprehensive search queries.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch
classes.description: A utility class for searching WorkEffort entities with various constraints such as associations, keywords, date ranges, and related entities. Contains nested classes for specific constraints and sorting orders.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch.WorkEffortSearchContext
classes.description: Maintains the state and parameters for a search operation, including constraints, sorting, and result processing.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch.WorkEffortSearchConstraint
classes.description: Abstract base class for defining search constraints applied to the WorkEffort search context.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch.WorkEffortAssocConstraint
classes.description: Constraint to filter WorkEfforts based on their associations, including sub-efforts.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch.WorkEffortReviewConstraint
classes.description: Constraint based on reviews associated with WorkEfforts, filtering by review text.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch.PartyAssignmentConstraint
classes.description: Constraint to filter WorkEfforts based on party assignments and roles.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch.ProductSetConstraint
classes.description: Constraint based on associated product IDs.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch.KeywordConstraint
classes.description: Constraint to perform keyword searches with options for prefix/suffix matching and logical conjunction/disjunction.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch.LastUpdatedRangeConstraint
classes.description: Filter WorkEfforts based on last modified date within a specified range.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch.ResultSortOrder
classes.description: Abstract class for defining the sorting order of search results.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch.SortKeywordRelevancy
classes.description: Sort results based on keyword relevancy score, typically descending.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearch.SortWorkEffortField
classes.description: Sort results based on a specified field in ascending or descending order.
